lines.text: One corner of the dark space is bustling with noise.
The girl and Marian watch the battle taking place around the Lift.
Leviathan narrowly manages to seize control of the nearby Dark Matter and create a massive wall to block the wave.
However, it soon reaches its limit. Just before the wall collapses, Ziz envelops everyone and soars into the sky.
Liberalio's body unleashes a swift, high-pressure torrent of water from one of its tentacles, sending Ziz crashing down.
Without giving the fallen party a moment to recover, Liberalio's body continues to blast jets of water from its tentacles.
At such a staggering size and height,
it does not dodge any of their attacks
It merely looks down with contempt and shoots blasts of water.
It is enormous, durable, and powerful,
to an unprecedented degree.
It does not possess any special abilities, or rather cannot use them,
as it lacks a brain to utilize all of its functions.
As such, it can do nothing but unleash attack after attack.
Liberalio was the second Heretic ever created.
Unlike the first Heretic, Anachiro, who was created almost by chance,
the second Heretic was created with clear intent, focus, and with everything available at the time.
And now, its overwhelming power is being fully unleashed.
Altruia and Egovista watch the scene from afar.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Commander... Everyone...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I've made up my mind.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I'm going over there.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: They're weak.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I'm strong.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I will go kill that thing in the sky, steal the gene, and become the Queen.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Yeah... That's what I've decided.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... Why?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Because I have to save them.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: do you want to become the Queen?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: ... No. I don't want to.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: But I have to.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: We can't let that thing be the Queen.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I felt something when I fought it.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: It only wants one thing.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: To kill everything except what it created.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: It will kill everyone...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: And try to start over.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: ... I don't want that. So I have to do it. I have to become the Queen.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: What do you want?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: A world where my friends and family are alive.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: No, I don't mean that.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I wasn't asking what kind of world you want to create.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I want you to tell me what you really want.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I want to live together with my sisters.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I want to spend time with Daddy and Mommy.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I want them to hug me, and take me places.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I want to laugh every day, and have fun.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... Wow, you are deeply loved.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: They give me hugs.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: They hugged me so much.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Can you not do those things if you become the Queen?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: You really don't know anything, huh?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: The Queen has to build the world together with the Seven Arbiters.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: That's her duty.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: She can't do anything else.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: ... I won't be able to ask for hugs.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I won't be able to go out to play, or even laugh.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I'll be lonely.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: But I still have to do it.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I am the only one who can defeat that thing.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I have to do it.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: If I don't, that thing will take over the world.
Marian slowly approaches the girl.
She sees the emotion in her seemingly empty eyes.
She quietly embraces the girl.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... The idea of becoming the Queen is really weighing on you.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: You're just a child who loves to play around and be hugged.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: And you're planning on giving that up for the ones you love.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: But it's okay.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: My sisters...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: have shown me so much love.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: So it's okay. I can become the Queen for them.
Marian embraces the girl even tighter.
The girl closes her eyes and lets her body yield to the comforting warmth.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: You're a good person too.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Everyone is good.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: ... But they are weak.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: That's why I have to become the Queen.
Marian feels a heartbeat.
Two heartbeats.
Two comforting scents.
Both are familiar, and a wave of nostalgia rushes over her.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I know this feeling...

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... Rapi.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: And... the Commander?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Yeah. Mommy and Daddy.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: They're my mommy and daddy.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Is that... so?
Marian closes her eyes.
She surrenders herself to the nostalgia,
to that warm and deeply familiar feeling.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hug me tighter.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Daddy must really like you.
Marian embraces the girl even tighter.
She feels her mind going blank,
as if everything is melting away.
She casts everything she is into that feeling.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Your head is glowing.
Marian's bandages begin to glow.
And then..

lines.speaker: marian_p
lines.text: No. I don't want to listen.

lines.speaker: marian_p
lines.text: No! I don't want to. I don't want that.

lines.speaker: marian_p
lines.text: I want to be with the Commander.

lines.speaker: marian_p
lines.text: So don't... please don't leave me.

lines.speaker: marian_p
lines.text: I want to be together with you.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: ... Are you going to shoot me?

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: Haha. I know you, Commander. You can't shoot me.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: You couldn't shoot me then, and you can't shoot me now.

lines.speaker: modenia
lines.text: You're a warm person. A kind person.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Over... here.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Comman...der!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Thank you... for your... bandage.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Please don't worry.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I will protect you.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Commander, I could use another bandage here as well.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: BA-01 down! BA-01 down!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Please respond! We've been shot down!

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: ... You want to be a Commander?

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: Why would you wanna be something like that?

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: I heard they don't make much money, and it's really dangerous.

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: Well, I'll root for you anyway. And your dream.

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: If...

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: And this is a big if...

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: If I ever become a Nikke...

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: I hope you'll be my Commander.

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: What's your name?

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}? Haha, that's a weird name.

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: Oh, I haven't even introduced myself.

lines.speaker: girl
lines.text: You can call me...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hey...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Are you crying?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Ohhh...
That's right...
I wanted to create a world where he wouldn't die.
A world where he could live happily.
A world where he could smile.
It's been so long...
A seemingly never-ending loop...
That's why...
I wanted to create a world where everyone can love one another.
A world where no one gets hurt, and no one hurts others.
A world filled with love.
That was what I wanted to create.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Give me your Queen Gene.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: ... You want it?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: No. You're too weak.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I was.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: But not anymore.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Now I know what I have to...

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: No, not "have to." Now I know what I want to do.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: More clearly than I ever have.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: So I'm not weak anymore.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I can win.
The girl gently pushes Marian away and takes a step back.
She looks at Marian, who is gazing back at her.
She fidgets with her fingers.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Can I really give it to you?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Yeah.
The girl fidgets with her fingers more,
then shakes her head firmly.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Everyone's so weak.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: They can't even beat that thing's minions.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Listen to me.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: They are never going to lose,

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: because they are the Goddesses of Victory.
